cohort: 2953 women in Sweden who answered a questionnaire during antenatal care and later gave birth.
finding: In Sweden, unplanned pregnancy was associated with later initiation of antenatal care, increased odds of induced labor, and longer hospital stays, but not with severe pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found that women with unplanned pregnancies had higher odds of having induced labor (17% vs 13%) compared to those with planned pregnancies.
